title: Data Use and Access Act: What Changed for UK Cold Email
meta_description: What the UK Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 means for cold email: direct marketing in Article 6(11), PECR fines at the higher maximum, a new complaints duty.
secondary_keywords: data use and access act direct marketing
data use and access act complaints

image.takeaway: Direct marketing is an Article 6(11) example, not one of the 5 recognised legitimate interests.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on the UK Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 for cold email senders: legitimate interests, PECR consent, the higher fine ceiling and the complaints duty.
